purpose: Two clean-source, same-binary fixed-arrival P01 baseline runs. Descriptive single-host evidence only; unavailable outcomes remain in the totals and this does not establish an SLO or production capacity.

environment.topology: One host release Rust process, Node TLS proxy and load generator; Docker Percona primary plus separate Redis cache/limiter containers on loopback. Chromium provisions real login/SSO credentials.

budgets.freshness: No stale grants for checks dispatched after committed reduction/revocation acknowledgement.

interpretation.databaseRoleNote: The browser benchmark uses a disposable database-owner fixture, not the Compose runtime-role topology.
limits: pool acquisition and authorization stage timings
SQL statement counts and WAL observations
multi-hour endurance and production arrival distributions
interpretation.rawReports: Full identifier-bearing reports and request traces remain in ignored .local/benchmarks directories. Run `make benchmark-arrivals-baseline` to regenerate them. This published summary preserves source/binary/image digests and per-phase/per-client aggregates.
